title: Ember.Latitude.S03E05.2026.1080p.WEB-DL.H264-DEADPOST
description: The same dead posting with too few files to be judged on its leading articles: four RAR volumes and five PAR2 sidecars, every article deleted from both servers. The health verdict has to decide it. The NZB advertises fifteen recovery blocks, and a deferral on that advertisement alone would hold the job for as long as it takes to prove every article missing; the deferral must instead ask whether any of that recovery can still be obtained — the metadata discovery probes its candidates, they are retired, discovery closes, and the health failure lands on the next check.
